diagnostics.summary: useEffect, useRenderEffect or onMount ran with no current owner.
diagnostics.fix: create the effect inside a component or createRoot; after an await, restore the owner with runWithOwner (see ownership).

diagnostics.summary: onCleanup(fn) ran with no current owner; fn is dropped and never runs.
diagnostics.fix: register cleanups inside a component, effect or createRoot, or inside runWithOwner(owner, ...) after an await.

diagnostics.summary: onError(handler) ran with no current owner; the handler can never be reached.
diagnostics.fix: call it inside the scope whose errors it should handle, or use catchError(fn, handler), which creates the scope for you.

diagnostics.summary: useId() ran outside any owner.
diagnostics.fix: call useId() in a component body or inside createRoot.

diagnostics.summary: A signal or store was written while a useMemo (or a compiler-derived constant) was computing.
diagnostics.fix: compute the value instead of storing it elsewhere; if a write is a real side effect, do it in useEffect.

diagnostics.summary: A memo read itself while it was running, directly or through another memo that had to recompute in the same pull.
diagnostics.fix: a value that depends on its own previous value is not a derivation. Use the previous argument that useMemo passes to its function, or keep the accumulator in a signal.

diagnostics.summary: Effects kept re-triggering each other for more than 1000 passes, so the flush was aborted and its queues cleared.
diagnostics.fix: read the previous value untracked (the updater form set((n) => n + 1) does), derive with a memo, or write from an event handler. See scheduler.

diagnostics.summary: flushSync() was called while a flush was already draining (inside an effect or a cleanup).
diagnostics.fix: remove the call. The flush that is running will process everything you write; if you need the DOM updated, read it in a later effect or after the flush.

diagnostics.summary: runWithOwner(owner, fn) received an owner that was already disposed.
diagnostics.fix: check owner.disposed before scheduling more work, or cancel the work in onCleanup.

diagnostics.summary: createRoot lists each copy of @shadow-js/core in a registry at globalThis[Symbol.for("shadow-js.core.instances")], with the number of its live roots, and warns DUPLICATE_CORE ("More than one copy of @shadow-js/core is loaded.
diagnostics.fix: make every package resolve one copy: npm ls @shadow-js/core must show a single version, deduplicated; in Vite add resolve.dedupe: ["@shadow-js/core", "@shadow-js/web"]; library packages must list core and web as peerDependencies.

diagnostics.summary: useContext(context) found no provider above it and the context has no default value.
diagnostics.fix: render the provider above the consumer, or give the context a default: createContext(defaultValue).

diagnostics.summary: Two items of a keyed list (<For key={...}> or mapArray with key) have the same key.
diagnostics.fix: use a key that is unique in the list, normally a database id.

diagnostics.summary: useEffect(fn, [deps]) was called with a React-style dependency array.
diagnostics.fix: drop the array to track what the body reads, or use useEffect(deps, fn) to track only what deps reads.

diagnostics.summary: A URL attribute (href, src, action, formaction, xlink:href, poster, data) was given a value that, after removing control characters and whitespace and lower-casing, starts with javascript:, data:text/html or vbscript:.
diagnostics.fix: never pass untrusted strings straight to a URL attribute; allow-list the scheme first.

diagnostics.summary: An attribute name that cannot appear in markup reached setAttribute, setAttributeNS, setBoolAttribute or, on the server, ssrAttribute / ssrElement.
diagnostics.fix: spread only keys you control, or filter them first.

diagnostics.summary: A value computed at run time was written to srcdoc.
diagnostics.fix: sanitize the document before it reaches the attribute, and give the frame a sandbox attribute (without allow-scripts and allow-same-origin together) so a document that slips through cannot reach your page.

diagnostics.summary: Dynamic was given an SVG element name in a case SVG does not spell it in (clippath, CLIPPATH, lineargradient, fegaussianblur, textpath, ...).
diagnostics.fix: write the name as SVG spells it.

diagnostics.summary: One element carries both class and className (or class twice).
diagnostics.fix: keep one, and join the class names into it.

diagnostics.summary: During hydrate() the client asked for the server element with a given key and the server HTML has none.
diagnostics.fix: render the same components in the same order on both sides; defer client-only content to onMount.

diagnostics.summary: useHead() ran with no current owner, so nothing was registered (a head tag must be removed when its owner is disposed).
diagnostics.fix: call useHead inside a component or createRoot.

diagnostics.summary: Portal has no mount element: mount was null, undefined from a function, or document.getElementById(...) found nothing.
diagnostics.fix: make sure the element exists when the portal is created, pass a function that returns it later, or omit mount to render into document.body.

diagnostics.summary: renderToStringAsync needed more than maxPasses passes (default 10): each pass resolved resources that, once resolved, made the app create new resources, a request waterfall.
diagnostics.fix: start independent requests together (create the resources in the same component pass), flatten the data flow, or raise maxPasses when the depth is intended.

diagnostics.summary: The render (renderToStringAsync, default 10 000 ms) or the stream (renderToStream, default 30 000 ms) did not finish within timeoutMs; the render is canceled and its roots are disposed.
diagnostics.fix: find the resource that never settles (a request without its own timeout), or raise timeoutMs.

diagnostics.summary: A value that cannot become markup reached the renderer (a plain object throws in development and renders nothing in production; a Symbol throws in both): a plain object, a Symbol (also as an attribute value, class name, style value or innerHTML), or a style that is not a string, object or array.
diagnostics.fix: render a field ({user.name}), not the object; stringify explicitly with JSON.stringify if you really want text.

diagnostics.summary: ssrElement(tag, ...) (used for elements with spread props) received a tag name that is not letters, digits and dashes starting with a letter.
diagnostics.fix: never build tag names from user input; map to an allow-list.

diagnostics.summary: An object passed as style (or inside a style array) has a key that is not a valid CSS property name, so it could break out of the style attribute.
diagnostics.fix: use real property names; do not take property names from user input.

diagnostics.summary: serialize(data) found a value it cannot represent: a function, a symbol, a class instance or another non-plain object.
diagnostics.fix: convert to plain data before it goes into resource results.
